name: Molecular Medicine PhD Program (Cleveland Clinic Lerner Research Institute)
summary: Molecular Medicine PhD at Cleveland Clinic integrating laboratory research with human disease and clinical/translational training.

publishedDeadlines.label: Application deadline (safer earlier source)
publishedDeadlines.note: Application page; no year. FAQ instead says January5. Confirm with program and plan for earlier deadline.

english.toefl: 5.0 on or after January21,2026; 90 iBT earlier; 577 paper
english.note: PTE Academic61 also accepted. Scores valid two years. TOEFL Home Edition accepted; Duolingo, IELTS Indicator/One Skill Retake, TOEFL Essentials/MyBest not accepted. Qualifying English-medium degree/home-language exemptions may apply. Unofficial scores for review; official after admission.

applicationFee.note: Central fee$85 conflicts with program FAQ$50; budget safer$85 and confirm. Program accepts requests with subject “MMED application fee waiver request.” International eligibility not expressly restricted, confirm.

documents: CV/resume and statement of purpose per central application
requirements.note: General biology, general chemistry, organic chemistry and biochemistry with C−or better before entry; molecular/cellular biology recommended. Extensive research not necessary but strong candidates generally have experience. One reference from current research mentor. All English tests completed by deadline. Competitive candidates interviewed; final decisions by February. First year begins mid-July.

funding.note: All accepted students receive stipend and free tuition throughout graduate training plus CWRU health insurance. Amount not stated on opened program pages.

detailsNote: Official information available; Fall 2027 dates not confirmed.
